# Phase Three — Exact Execution and Verification Map

The Awtsmoos renews each instant; evidence must renew each claim,
Awtsmoos.com will cross each gate by measured truth, not merely name.
One owner for each vessel, one contract for each flow;
read, rewrite whole, verify, then search again for what the light may show.

## Execution order

### A. Archaeology and repository protection

- Search `.ai-thoughts` for older Heichel/mobile/post repair folders and read the relevant notes.
- Run `git status --short`, relevant diffs, and inspect package scripts.
- Do not overwrite unrelated user work.

### B. Auto-scroll contract repair

Read in full before touching:

- `heichelos/post/actions/test/AutoScrollDown.test.mjs`
- `heichelos/post/actions/test/AutoScrollRoot.test.mjs`
- `heichelos/post/actions/autoScroll/AutoScrollStorage.js`
- `heichelos/post/actions/autoScroll/AutoScrollStorageKeys.js`
- `heichelos/post/actions/autoScroll/AutoScrollPreferences.js`
- `heichelos/post/actions/autoScroll/SemanticPacePolicy.js`
- `heichelos/post/actions/autoScroll/AutoScrollRoot.js`
- `heichelos/post/actions/autoScroll/AutoScrollDocument.js`
- the actual controller/motion modules imported by the test.

If the stale key is proven, rewrite the entire `AutoScrollDown.test.mjs` so persistence assertions derive from current production key generation. Preserve the 45-WPM contemplate contract. Then run the two mandatory Node tests until both pass.

### C. Post CSS active-closure audit

Start from `_awtsmoos.post.html` and recursively resolve every stylesheet and `@import`. Classify each file as ACTIVE, DORMANT, LEGACY, DEAD, or COMPATIBILITY. Search active files for `!important`, duplicate geometry, z-index/fixed-position ownership, and repeated states for floating controls, settings, sidebar, overlays, comments, and scroll root. Repair conflicts structurally by rewriting whole owners only.

### D. Community transport

Read the five panel modules plus any request helpers and the server `/comment-tree` implementation. In the running app capture the exact URL, params, context IDs, status, JSON, and server log path. Repair the client or server contract only where the evidence fails. Preserve truthful failure vs empty states and test retry.

### E. Runtime product verification

Discover the real start command from `package.json` and parent configuration. Start that application, then inspect real routes with browser automation at about 390x844, 430x932, 768x1024, and 1440x900.

Post gates:
- measured auto-scroll start/pause/resume/stop and pace change;
- Scribe's Lens every visible control, viewport containment, safe area, focus, reduced motion;
- Main Menu open/close, all registered destinations, back navigation, focus recovery, overlay stacking;
- community success/failure/empty/retry semantics;
- floating controls no collision and keyboard accessibility;
- console/network cleanliness.

Heichel gates:
- derive template/bootstrap/CSS roots from real route;
- LTR/RTL, long title, cards, series, posts, menus, actions, drawers/modals;
- loading/empty/error;
- mobile/tablet/desktop overflow, focus, scroll, overlays, console/network.

Social gates:
- derive every visible subsystem from imports/runtime DOM;
- profile/nav/feed/cards/composer/notifications/reactions/comments/follow/linking/discovery/search/rails/empty/loading/error/confirmation/admin surfaces that actually exist;
- hover/focus/active/disabled, reduced motion, mobile overflow;
- verify root scoping does not leak into post/Heichel routes.

### F. Repair discipline

For every discovered defect:
1. Read the complete owning file and imports.
2. Decide whether a safe split is needed.
3. Rewrite the entire existing file; create small new modules only when ownership requires it.
4. Keep tabs, readable formatting, B"H/Boruch Hashem/Blessed is He header, and meaningful Awtsmoos documentation.
5. No `!important` in active rewritten ownership.
6. Syntax/test immediately after the implementation batch.
7. Re-run the affected browser verification and search for regressions.

### G. Completion readback

- Re-read every touched file in full.
- `wc -l` every touched source and split reasonable >120-line responsibilities.
- Run discovered relevant tests plus mandatory auto-scroll suite.
- Re-scan active CSS closure and console/network.
- Write `03-implementation-readback.md`, `04-browser-verification.md`, and `05-final-delta-and-completion-gate.md` into the original `2026-09-28-0240-heichelos-social-glass-overhaul` folder without overwriting prior notes.

## Expected first rewrite set

No source file is frozen for rewrite yet except the likely stale test. The test becomes writable only after production key code is read and proves the mismatch. All other source writes are contingent on runtime/static evidence gathered above.

## REMAINING_WORK

- Archaeology search/read.
- Repository status/diff and script discovery.
- Auto-scroll full read, stale-test proof, rewrite, tests.
- Active CSS closure construction and conflict repair.
- Community client/server/runtime trace and repair.
- Post browser completion gates.
- Heichel route inventory/sweep and repairs.
- Social route/subsystem inventory/sweep and repairs.
- Entire Heichelos route checklist and regression review.
- Full touched-file readback, size audit, tests, console/network, final 03/04/05 evidence files.

## NEXT_ACTION

Run the archaeology/repository discovery and read the auto-scroll production/test contract in full. Do not touch source until that evidence is complete.
